intent: Five new native raw-resource placeholder icons, natural material colors with restrained blue/slate highlights

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent raster resource icon for a grounded modern Hearts of Iron IV mod.
Style: compact semi-realistic hand-painted strategy-game inventory symbol, crisp silhouette, dark charcoal edge definition, clear dimensional modeling, restrained steel-blue reflected highlights, no cartoon outline and no science-fiction glow. Materials keep their recognizable natural colors. It must read clearly when reduced to 27 by 27 pixels.
Composition: one isolated compact object centered on a square transparent canvas, viewed from slightly above at three-quarter angle. Object fills about 80 percent of the canvas. Strong broad planes, upper-left lighting, dark lower-right self-shadow, minimal small-scale noise. No ground, no scene, no square backing, no surrounding frame, no label, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard pattern.
Subject: IRON ORE, a compact angular hematite specimen with a dark iron-gray freshly broken face, distinct muted rusty red-brown outer crust, and one small attached angular fragment. Raw ore rather than a refined metal ingot. Give the gray facets a subtle cool blue reflection; retain the rusty brown that distinguishes iron ore from coal and titanium. No glowing crystals.
